user_query: I'm looking for a new house in Rabat. Can you find me a list of available houses for sale in Rabat and their details using the Avito Scraper API? Additionally, provide me with the NAICS code and description for the real estate industry using the Industry NAICS Search API.

TaskList.description: Use the Avito Scraper API to find a list of available houses for sale in Rabat and retrieve their details.
Use the Industry NAICS Search API to retrieve the NAICS code and description for the real estate industry.
